context: Mei and Aoi laugh about an exhausting weekend.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (死ぬ/死ん/爆/がんばっ/かける) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 週末、掃除で死ぬほど疲れたの。
lines.en: On the weekend, I was dead tired from cleaning.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle weary delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: Did you work hard on your own?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん、一日かけてがんばったの。
lines.en: Yeah, I spent the whole day at it.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 終わって、ベッドで爆睡したでしょ?
lines.en: Done, you crashed in bed, right?
lines.style: giggly barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Yeah, I slept like the dead.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 掃除機、途中で死んでなかった?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 死んだから、ほうきに切り替えたの。
lines.en: It died, so I switched to a broom.
lines.style: rueful woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 今度は、二人でがんばろうね!
lines.en: Next time, let's work hard together!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
